verdict.rationale: Docs describe stable-ID reconnection (getSandbox) and sessions with persistent state/env, suggesting sandboxes could be resumed across long tasks, but community reports explicitly say containers auto-shutdown after idle periods, that there's no built-in idle-timeout control (forcing manual cleanup), and that persistence semantics during idle states are unclear — directly undercutting reliable multi-hour/day continuous operation for unattended agent tasks. Missing for 10: first-party guidance on running sessions continuously for hours/days without disconnection, clear idle-timeout/keep-alive controls, and independent confirmation of long-duration reliability.
